title: Audio Analysis Services
headline: Listen beyond the obvious.
intro: Sound holds structure, timing and evidence that can disappear when everything is reduced to a transcript.
summary: Alchemy audio work includes layered analysis, signal pattern discovery, search, forensic-oriented techniques and durable processing pipelines.

sections.heading: Signal first, interpretation second
sections.body: A detected acoustic pattern is not automatically a cause, a speaker identity or an allegation. Workflows should preserve the distinction between measured features, derived hypotheses and human conclusions.

sections.heading: Search what is audible
sections.body: Audio search and locator work seeks repeatable segments, localisable events and relationships across recordings. Layered analysis can preserve intermediate evidence rather than replace it with a single uninspectable score.

sections.heading: Built to continue
sections.body: Long-running media tasks benefit from job checkpoints, migration semantics and durable storage. Portable definitions can allow the same analytical task to be admitted on suitable nodes of the MI/MU fabric.
points: Separation of work from machine paths
